incident-bot: :rotating_light: pager duty: page fired for service=edge-proxy, symptom=TLS handshake failures, severity=2
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-6024 opened — notified: #incidents, oncall-liz
oncall-liz: acked. seeing elevated TLS handshake errors in us-east-1 and elevated 502s in API gateway. grabbing details now.
sre_tom: Im looking at TLS traces. Some nodes return correct cert, others return a default cert CN=staging.internal. SNI mismatch suspected. Doing openssl s_client and curl tests.
netops_sara: Target group tg-edge-us-east-1b shows increased UnHealthyCount. CloudWatch shows a deploy event ~12m before alert spike.
eng_kate: We promoted an envoy config canary 12m ago to 10% traffic. That canary included a fallback cert for staging we thought was gated. Investigating whether file path was misconfigured.
oncall-liz: timeline: deploy @1952238200 (~11.5m ago). Alerts @1952238860. Correlated.
sre_tom: logs:
```
# check cert
openssl s_client -connect 10.12.78.91:443 -servername api.prod.example.com -showcerts
# curl showing handshake failure
curl -v https://10.12.78.91/ -H 'Host: api.prod.example.com'
```

sre_tom: openssl output returned certificate with subject CN=staging.internal on half the instances. others are ok. So canary likely mounting wrong cert.
eng_kate: Confirmed: the canary build included tests/fixtures/certs/test.pem and ENV var CERT_PATH defaulted to /etc/ssl/certs/active.pem in the image. Due to a packaging change the test cert landed at that path.
netops_sara: ALB listener rules unchanged. Behavior indicates instance-level serving cert was wrong.
eng_kate: Mitigation plan: immediate rollback of canary image on tg-edge-v2. If rollback slow, fallback would be to deregister tg-edge-v2 from ALB to force traffic to prior target group. Rollback preferred.
oncall-liz: PD annotation: mitigation chosen = rollback to previous image, initiated.
eng_kate: rollback triggered at 1952238930 (deploy rollback job id rb-9911). Starting rolling restart across availability zones.
sre_tom: Im watching handshake error rate now. Beginning to drop as instances complete rollback.
netops_sara: Temporarily increasing target group deregistration delay to 300s to reduce connection churn during rollout.
cs_raj: Customer impact: Support saw spikes in TLS failures for API clients between ~13:34-13:46 UTC; drafting comms now.
eng_kate: rollback status: 30% @1952238955, 70% @1952238978, 100% @1952239005. Post-rollback cert check across nodes shows api.prod.example.com cert served consistently.
sre_tom: health checks green, target group now reports 6/6 healthy. TLS handshake error rate returned to baseline.
oncall-liz: PD-6024 will remain open for 15m monitoring window. Leaving note to update PD once stable.
cs_raj: Customer message posted to #customer-updates: "We experienced intermittent TLS failures affecting API requests in us-east-1 due to a canary configuration that served a test certificate. The change was rolled back and service recovered. Were investigating remediation steps."
eng_kate: Actions: Ill add CI validation to fail builds that include test cert paths; add a canary smoke test for SNI/cert verification; and adjust image packaging to separate test certs from prod path. Opening action item ticket PM-1507.
sre_tom: Also adding an alert rule to detect cert CN mismatches against expected hostnames during canary windows.
netops_sara: Will update rollout docs: restrict file paths in images and add an automated SNI check post-rollout.
oncall-liz: handoff: I need to step out at 1952239012 — @sre_tom please monitor until 1952240100. Thanks all.
incident-bot: PD-6024 status: resolved (ack closed) after monitoring window.
eng_kate: filing postmortem and linking artifacts and timeline.
cs_raj: sending final customer note after postmortem approved.
oncall-liz: great job everyone :thumbsup: — closing thread once monitoring ends.
